title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: The Compliance API local session endpoints now also return transcripts of Claude in Chrome sessions (product_surface value claude_in_chrome), in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations, with your existing Compliance Access Key and the read:compliance_user_data scope. See Sessions on users' machines.
